name: Pesto Sausage & Bean Traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Slice the potatoes thinly and cut the onion into wedges.
Tip the potatoes, onion, tomatoes, spring onions and sausage chunks into a large tray with the oil. Roast for 20 minutes, until the sausages are browned.
Stir in the drained beans, stock cube dissolved in 200ml hot water, and half the pesto, with lemon wedges alongside.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes more until the potatoes are tender and the sausages are cooked through, then drizzle with the rest of the pesto.
